scripts.build: tsc -p packages/client/tsconfig.json && node tools/build-client.mjs && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=15000 build/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:interop: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && uv run --locked --project tests/interop python tests/interop.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:types && npm test && npm run test:workers
scripts.test:workers: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.workers.json && node tools/test-workers.mjs
